Use case: single-character reconstruction reference for TRELLIS image-to-3D, for a cozy prehistoric Ice Age open-world adventure game. Style: cute Japanese mobile-game chibi 3D character exactly in the style of the attached cast reference image (same game, same cast): a low-poly game model with crisp hand-painted anime textures, soft painted shading on rounded 3D forms (it must read clearly as a 3D model render, not a flat 2D drawing), clean dark-brown painted outlines along clothing edges and hair locks. Super-deformed proportions, about 2.6 heads tall: a very large round head (about 38% of the total height) with a small rounded chin, a small compact body, short limbs, small simple hands with the fingers held together, chunky boots. Anime face: very large glossy eyes with coloured irises, two white catchlights and a dark upper lash line, small simple eyebrows, a tiny nose that is only a small painted mark, a small happy closed-mouth smile, soft blush. Hair painted as a few large clean locks with soft shading and one clean highlight band, no individual strands; hair and any hood stay on the head: no lock or long hair rests on the shoulders, chest or back, and nothing covers the eyes or the face. ONE cheerful young Cro-Magnon child of the Ice Age (Upper Palaeolithic), as described below. Cro-Magnon details shared by the cast: clothes of tanned hide and soft fur sewn with visible stitches, ornaments of pierced shells, animal teeth, bone or mammoth ivory, red-ochre paint motifs, a leather belt or sash with a small pouch, soft hide boots with fur cuffs and cross-laced leather cords. Modest clothing. POSE: symmetrical A-pose for rigging, standing straight, facing the camera directly, arms straight down and out at about 35-40 degrees from the body with a clear empty gap between each arm and the body and between each hand and the clothes, legs straight and slightly apart with a clear gap between the legs and between the boots, feet flat and pointing forward, empty open hands, no props. Camera: straight-on front view at chest height, orthographic-like, the entire figure from the top of the hair (and any hood, ears, tusks or ornament) to the boot soles uncropped with generous margin, centered. Lighting: soft even neutral studio light, no harsh highlights, no dark cast shadows on the figure, only a faint contact shadow. Plain uniform off-white background. No text, logo, watermark, scenery, ground plane, base, pedestal, weapon, second figure or multiple views.
